From: Anna Hobbs <anna.hobbs@northbridge.edu>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: pilot pricing for university research / nonprofit rate?

Hi Grace,

We run a small AI research pilot at Northbridge University and are evaluating hosted inference options for a 6-month research collaboration starting in Q4. Typical monthly usage would be around 2–4M tokens (in bursts around grading windows).

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood has a standard academic/nonprofit rate for hosted API consumption (we saw references to academic programs but need details),
- If you offer baseline pricing exceptions for university pilots that exceed free credits, and
- What proof you require to validate nonprofit/academic eligibility.

Also, we may need invoicing to be sent to our central finance address (accounts@northbridge.edu) and invoice terms Net 30. Happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call if helpful.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Hobbs
Director, AI Research Initiatives
Northbridge University
[anna.hobbs@northbridge.edu]

Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot pricing for university research / nonprofit rate?

Hi Anna —

Thanks for reaching out and congrats on getting the pilot scoped. Short answers: yes, we have an academic/nonprofit program and we can consider a baseline pricing exception for multi-month pilots like this — subject to verification and a short MOU.

Next steps I recommend:
- Quick discovery call so Ben can understand traffic profile (burstiness, token length distribution) and Marcus can confirm invoicing/terms.
- I attached our Q3 rate card for reference and a sample pilot proposal template (see attachment).
- If you have institutional paperwork (proof of nonprofit status or a letter from grants office), please share — that speeds approvals.

Suggested times for a 20-min call: Thu 9/9 10:00 or 14:00 PT. Which works?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Hobbs <anna.hobbs@northbridge.edu>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Inquiry: pilot pricing for university research / nonprofit rate?

Grace / Marcus —

I took a pass at a commercial approach for Northbridge's pilot. Key points below; I attached a draft proposal PDF with line-item pricing.

Proposal highlights (pilot, 6 months):
- Baseline: $0.30 / 1K tokens for generation usage (hosted API), applied to committed baseline of 2M tokens/month.
- Overage: $0.22 / 1K tokens beyond baseline up to 5M tokens/month.
- Academic discount: 15% off list for verified nonprofit/university accounts (requires one of: IRS 501(c)(3) equivalency, university charter, or signed MOU).
- Invoicing: Net 30 available; billing to accounts@northbridge.edu.

Conditions and items for underwriting:
1) Verification documentation from Northbridge (scan/letter).
2) MOU confirming pilot scope (sample in attached).
3) Security questionnaire outcome — standard answers OK; if any red flags the security team may require additional controls.

Attachments: proposal-northbridge-pilot-v1.pdf (draft pricing + SOW).

If Anna is comfortable with the economics, I can formalize and route to finance for a one-time baseline pricing exception for the pilot. Marcus — please confirm approval path for the discount and Net 30.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposal-northbridge-pilot-v1.pdf]
From: Anna Hobbs <anna.hobbs@northbridge.edu>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Security <it_security@northbridge.edu>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot pricing for university research / nonprofit rate?

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A couple of quick clarifications from finance/security:

1) Can we set committed baseline to 3M tokens/month instead of 2M? Our usage estimates are closer to that and it would reduce overage volatility.
2) Confirmed: billing should go to accounts@northbridge.edu, Net 30 is fine.
3) Our security team will want a quick data handling note: are logs retained by default, and can they be configured to be disabled/limited for university accounts? Also any SOC2 / ISO attestations you can share would be great.

If you can reflect the 3M baseline in the revised proposal and share a short note on logs retention, we'll be prepared to move to MOU and DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to take the call Thu 9/9 14:00 PT.

Anna
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Hobbs <anna.hobbs@northbridge.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: pilot pricing for university research / nonprofit rate? — next steps

Anna — great, 14:00 PT works for us. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Baseline: Ben will update the proposal to reflect a 3M tokens/month committed baseline and re-calc the blended rates; we can still apply the 15% academic discount upon verification.
- Logs & data handling: By default we retain request/response logs for 30 days; for verified academic pilots we can reduce retention to 7 days and disable persistent debug logging. I'll loop in our security team if you need SOC2 report or an ISO attestation (we have both).
- Invoicing & terms: Marcus — please confirm routing and who signs the one-time baseline exception.

Action items:
1) Ben to send revised proposal and DocuSign link (includes MOU) — target 9/9 EOD PT.
2) Anna to share verification docs with Grace (scan of university letter or equivalent).
3) Grace to send security evidence pack (sample) for IT review.

I'll attach a small zip with sample security evidence to help speed IT review. Talk 14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-evidence-sample.zip]
